name: zovo-epub-reader
displayName: EPUB Viewer, EPUB Reader & Ebook Reader
description: EPUB viewer and EPUB reader for ebooks in VS Code. Paged or scrolled reading, table of contents, search, footnote popups, light, sepia and dark themes, and it remembers your page. Book scripts never run.

enumDescriptions: Turn pages like a book. Wide editors show two columns.
Scroll each chapter as one long page.
epubReader.flow.description: How chapters are laid out. The toolbar can switch it.

enumDescriptions: Use the colors of your VS Code theme.

epubReader.fontSize.description: Text size in pixels. The A− and A+ buttons change it.

epubReader.fontFamily.description: Book font. Serif is a book face, sans uses the VS Code interface font.

epubReader.footnotePopups.description: Show footnotes in a small popup when you click a note number, and hide EPUB 3 footnote boxes from the page.

epubReader.rememberPosition.description: Open each book where you stopped reading. Positions stay on this computer.

epubReader.maxFileMB.description: Books up to this size are opened. Larger files show a message and are not read.

epubReader.askForRating.description: Ask one time for a Marketplace rating after you have used EPUB Reader for a few days. You can answer "Later" or "Don't ask again". Nothing is sent anywhere.

epubReader.showSupportLinks.description: Show the small Sponsor and More free viewers links at the bottom of the viewer. The change shows in files you open next. Nothing is sent anywhere.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with EPUB Reader
walkthroughs.description: Read EPUB books in a VS Code tab.

steps.title: Open an EPUB book
steps.description:
Click any .epub file in the Explorer. Use the arrow keys, the page edges or the mouse wheel to turn pages.
[Find an EPUB file](command:workbench.action.quickOpen?%5B%22.epub%22%5D)

media.altText: A sample book in EPUB Reader, paged in two columns with the sepia theme and the table of contents open.

steps.title: Search and footnotes
steps.description: Type in the search box and press Enter to list every match. Press Enter again for the next one. Click a note number to read the footnote in a popup.

steps.title: Theme, size and layout
steps.description:
Pick a theme, the text size and paged or scrolled reading. Your choice is kept for every book.
[Open settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22epubReader%22%5D)

scripts.package: npm run build && npx -y @vscode/vsce package --no-dependencies -o dist/
